pages.text: Each finished transmission prints one reward. A transmitter within 32 blocks gets it; otherwise the console holds it for whoever opens it next.

pages.title: Relay Transcripts
pages.text: Three records, shared by the world, always first when due. Use a printed transcript to file it in the manual under $(bold)ORSA Intelligence$().$(br2)The console's Archive tab lists what's arrived.

pages.title: Resupply Plot
pages.text: A crash site 150-300 blocks away, inside the dashed circle.

pages.title: Supply Drop
pages.text: Crates hold Power Cells, two O2 cartridges, food and one rare part: a Signal Processor, Feed Horn or Thermal Core.$(br2)Within 30 blocks its beacon pings with distance and direction.

pages.title: Signal Plot
pages.text: An unvisited monitoring station or reactor site 200-900 blocks away.

pages.title: Reading Plots
pages.text: Plots show only the signal and your console, no terrain. A sector and range are printed, e.g. NE, ~300 m.$(br2)A $(l:signals/plumb_line)Plumb Line$(/l) pulse marks ORSA sites nearby.
